description: This file defines the tlHTMLTable class used for generating HTML tables in the TestLink project. It extends a base class tlTable and provides methods for rendering tables with specific styles, including support for rendering status and priority cells.

classes.name: tlHTMLTable
classes.description: A helper class for generating styled HTML tables, specifically for documents and spreadsheets in the TestLink project. It provides methods to render table headers, body, status, and priority cells.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializes the HTML table with column definitions, data, and optional table ID. It also loads configuration for status colors and urgency labels.

methods.name: renderCommonGlobals
methods.description: Placeholder method that performs no actions, indicating all rendering is done in renderBodySection.

methods.name: renderHeadSection
methods.description: Placeholder method that performs no actions, indicating all rendering is done in renderBodySection.

methods.name: renderBodySection
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the table body, including headers and data rows, with support for status and priority cell rendering.

methods.name: renderStatus
methods.description: Renders a status cell as a span with a CSS class and text based on the item data.

methods.name: renderPriority
methods.description: Renders a priority label by converting a priority code to a localized label using lang_get.
